payload.author: claude
payload.body: Shipped reusable load harness as new @fricken/bench package (bench/). Run: pnpm load:harness [--users N --appends-per-user N --object-writes-per-user N --seed N --no-subscribe --pretty]; FRICK_LOAD_* env fallbacks; --http-url/--ws-url to target an external server. Spins up in-process createFrickServer on ephemeral port + :memory: SQLite (logger silenced), drives synthetic users (HTTP dev-login + WS Hello + subscribe + object upserts + stream appends), emits one JSON result to stdout (config, env, per-op count/errors/p50/p90/p99/throughput, totals). Programmatic: runLoad()/parseLoadConfig(). Foundation for FR-97-100. Test: apps/server/tests/load-harness.test.ts (tiny e2e, asserts shape). Gate green: typecheck exit 0; server vitest 823 passed | 45 skipped.
